cases.name: Jennifer L. Howard
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She grew up in the area and attended schools in Rogers. Jennifer’s greatest passion in life was simply loving everyone around her and being selflessly at the service of everyone in her life. When her family and friends look back, their favorite memories all boil down to this incredible devotion. She possessed a rare and beautiful ability to completely put aside her own problems to show up for others. Jennifer was also an exceptionally vibrant person who absolutely loved the entire rainbow of bright colors. Her natural curiosity, independent "do-it-yourself" spirit, love for arts and crafts, and dedicated care for animals brought immense light and joy to everyone who knew her."
